title: Double Dark Chocolate Granita
changes_from_base: Coffee, cocoa and dark chocolate replace the strawberry purée.
summary: A rich and icy frozen dessert combining deep coffee notes with a double hit of intense dark chocolate.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Heat base
steps.text: Whisk 480 ml coffee, 130 g sugar, 50 g cocoa and a pinch of salt in the saucepan. Stir over medium heat until the mixture is smooth and steaming.

steps.title: Add chocolate
steps.text: Remove the pan from the heat and whisk in 85 g chopped dark chocolate and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir until the chocolate is completely melted and the liquid is glossy.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Transfer the mixture to a bowl and leave to chill until cold. This should take about 2 h.

steps.title: First freeze
steps.text: Pour the liquid into a lidded plastic freezer box and place in the freezer. Stir with a fork once every hour for about 5 h to create icy shards.

steps.title: Final set
steps.text: Leave the box in the freezer for a further 3 h to freeze completely. This ensures the texture remains firm and crisp.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scrape and break up the frozen mixture with a fork before serving. Spoon the dark crystals into chilled bowls to enjoy the caffeine and cocoa hit.

tips: Use dark chocolate with high cocoa solids for a more intense and sophisticated flavour profile.
Ensure the coffee is freshly brewed to provide the most aromatic base for the cocoa.
Serve in pre-chilled glasses to prevent the delicate ice crystals from melting too quickly.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week and use a fork to break up the crystals before serving.
